fact: UNFPA Djibouti reports that, following a national workshop it dates to 2 February 2025, GBV indicators are to be integrated progressively into the national DHIS2 with UNFPA's technical and financial support, and that the Ministry of Health ensures national governance of the integrated platform while the Health Information Directorate (DIS) manages its operational administration, including user access, data analysis and analytical reports.
title: Strengthening the Governance of Gender-Based Violence Data: Integrating GBVIMS-Health into DHIS2 in Djibouti
